source_review: Only two owned mutation exception handlers broadened from Exception to BaseException. Existing caller-transaction guards remain outside try; no transaction ownership, commit, audit/outbox, or projection reordering. The exception is re-raised after rollback.
compatibility: Existing nested-entry guards remain outside try, so caller-owned transactions are never rolled back. All six original fresh ownership tests are unchanged and pass. Normal success, ordinary callback failure, and post-commit behavior are unchanged.
execution_scope: Fake transaction state and a custom BaseException subclass only. No real signals/interrupts, database, model, production or credential access. Standard-library unittest; full pytest suite not run.
